mapper.select: with w as ( select wo_id, plan_start, plan_end from prd_wo where status in ('RELEASED', 'IN_PROGRESS') and plant_cd = #{plantCd} ) select (select count(*) from w where w.plan_start <= #{today}) as wo_cnt, (select count(*) from w where w.plan_end < #{today}) as overdue_cnt, (select count(*) from prd_wo_proc p join w on w.wo_id = p.wo_id where p.status = 'RUN') as run_cnt, (select count(*) from prd_wo_proc p join w on w.wo_id = p.wo_id where p.status = 'PAUSE') as pause_cnt
select count(*) from lot_master m where m.hold_yn = 'Y' and hb_lot_balance(m.lot_id) > 0

select m.lot_no, i.item_cd, trim_scale(hb_lot_balance(m.lot_id))::text as balance, m.unit_cd, m.hold_reason, (m.created_at at time zone #{zone})::date as created_on -- 회사 날짜(LOT 목록 기간이 회사 시간대로 자른다 — DB 세션 시간대 금지) from lot_master m join mst_item i on i.item_id = m.item_id where m.hold_yn = 'Y' and hb_lot_balance(m.lot_id) > 0 -- 오래 묵은 보류 먼저(6단계, docs/37 18.2): 살아 있는 보류 근거(V109 lot_hold) 중 가장 이른 held_at. -- updated_at 은 보류 동기화·버전 증가마다 바뀌어 순서가 흔들린다. 근거 행이 없던 옛 보류는 맨 앞(null first) order by (select min(h.held_at) from lot_hold h where h.lot_id = m.lot_id and h.released_at is null) nulls first, m.lot_id limit #{limit}
